metadata.title: Non-planar contact structures with Calabi-Yau Fillings and topological quantum computation
metadata.abstract: This paper is a non-planar counterpart of the author's earlier work on planar contact structures and topological quantum computation. There the page is planar and all branch points are paired by disjoint liftable arcs, compatibly with the joint eigenlines of the Ising representation and with Calabi-Yau (CY) Stein fillings, those with vanishing first Chern class. Here the page has genus g and connected binding, presented as a simple degree-three cover of the disk. Every maximal system of disjoint liftable arcs has exactly g members and leaves two branch points unused. The half-twist interchanging the two points is not liftable, but its cube is, and lifts to the identity. An integral residue criterion supplies the CY test. A factorization localized on a contact connected sum is automatically CY. Unlike in the planar case, a CY factorization need not be the shortest. Once the fusion channels of the g pairs are fixed, Ising fusion determines the channel of the remaining pair, and braiding acts there only by scalars. Fibonacci fusion can leave that channel undetermined, and the powers of the cube then act by ten distinct relative phases on a single joint eigenspace, while the CY Stein filling stays fixed

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 以三重分支圆盘覆盖描述带正亏格页面的开书，研究可提升弧、半扭转立方及第一 Chern 类为零的 Stein 填充，并比较 Ising 与 Fibonacci 融合通道的相位行为。
analysis.breakthrough: 把先前平面接触结构讨论扩展到非平面页面，揭示固定填充下不同融合理论的差别。
analysis.limitations: 量子计算解释依赖指定表示与通道设置，不能直接宣称提供通用量子计算方案。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于文献检索、计算核验、帮助细化关键论证的讨论和文风改进，同时称研究方向、定义、证明和最终文字由本人负责；不将讨论直接推定为模型提出核心路线。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25878v1 · 第14页 Declaration on the use of AI tools

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于文献检索、计算核验、帮助细化关键论证的讨论和文风改进，同时称研究方向、定义、证明和最终文字由本人负责；不将讨论直接推定为模型提出核心路线。

analysis.priorityReason: 接触拓扑与量子计算的专门交叉，宜结合配套论文阅读。
